item.title: Lachlan Star Moves to Acquire New Waverley Gold Project in WA’s Norseman Region
item.description: Lachlan Star (ASX: LSA) to acquire 90% of high-grade New Waverley Gold Project in WA's Norseman region, with imminent March drilling.

item.title: Nova Minerals Advances US Move, Acquires Remaining Interest in Estelle Gold Project
item.description: Nova Minerals to redomicile in the US, buys remaining 15% of Estelle gold project in Alaska, seeks US CFO as it readies Nova Minerals Corp for Nasdaq listing.

item.description: Iondrive's IONSolv delivers 85%+ silver recovery in lab, boosting solar recycling; advances with Livium toward end-of-life PV materials.
